tips.text: Refine Axi B9 to Radiant and run it in a four-player radshare; four Radiant relics give a 34.39% chance of at least one Rare.
Run the Systems relic Intact; Radiant lowers its Common odds from 25.33% to 16.67%.
Join the Vaulted Relic Community Discord for vaulted-relic squads; recruit chat rarely has them, and filtering by the exact relic name helps if you host.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; you keep the item and they get extra Void Traces.
Let enemies corrupt before you kill them so the squad collects enough Reactant.
Do not extract until everyone has 10 Reactant; in Excavation run one excavator at a time, and in Interception hold only two points.
Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Expect one or two evenings once his relics are in Varzia's stock; the calendar is the bottleneck, not the grind.
Expect to crack Axi B9 many times; it carries the Blueprint and Neuroptics but gives one reward per player per crack.
Buy extra Axi B9 relics; it is the only one of her relics that carries the Blueprint.
Buy her relics from the Market console on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Earn Aya from bounties rather than spending Steel Essence or standing on relic packs, which give about a quarter Aya each.
Try the base Baruuk before spending a vault window on the Prime; opinions on his kit are split.
Finish the mission before the escape timer runs out; failing it voids the relic reward.
Wait until the squad has picked relics before pressing Start; on console the same button can launch the mission.
